rows.grounds: ablative of cause; denotes inertia or dullness
ablative of cause; denotes active undertaking

items.question: What further conditions impel a person toward inauspicious actions?
premises: Stupor can function as a motivating condition.
Exertion may be directed toward inauspicious actions.
These conditions extend the previously listed causes.
items.inference: Stupor and exertion in inauspicious actions are additional impelling conditions.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic scope of tu in relation to samudyogāt is slightly ambiguous.
items.plain_english: And from stupor, and also from exertion in inauspicious actions.
